description: Free, no key, no wallet: quote any pair across eight routers (KyberSwap, LI.FI, Uniswap, 0x, SushiSwap, 1inch, Velora, Nordstern) without building a transaction. Returns the best amount out, already net of the Trnch fee, the router and the fee rate in basis points (feeBps). Covers the official Stock Tokens of Robinhood Chain too. 409 if a token is not tradable through Trnch. A transaction (trnch_buy, trnch_sell) needs an API key. A partner's integrator fee (integratorFeeBps, or the partner's default fee when the request carries X-Trnch-Partner-Key) is added to the Trnch fee and taken by the same router fee on every router; a router whose maximum fee is below the total is left out of the quote. The integrator fee is paid to the partner through the Trnch partner program after the swap is confirmed on chain. fees in the response: { side, token, trnch { bps, amount }, integrator { bps, amount, partner } or null, minAmountOut }, amounts in the smallest unit; minAmountOut is net of both fees and of slippage.

amountIn.description: Amount of tokenIn in its smallest unit (wei-style integer string).

decimalsIn.description: Decimals of tokenIn. Default 18: set it for USDG (6) and other non-18 tokens.

decimalsOut.description: Decimals of tokenOut. Default 18: set it for USDG (6) and other non-18 tokens.

fast.description: Return the first clean quote after about 250 ms instead of waiting for the best price. May return a slightly worse price (partial: true when a slower router was cut). Default false.

integratorFeeBps.description: Integrator fee in basis points, 0 to 100, for a partner identified by X-Trnch-Partner-Key or by the partner ref of the API key. Overrides the partner's default fee; the default fee applies only with X-Trnch-Partner-Key, never through the partner ref of the API key alone. Without a partner, a value above 0 is refused.

slippage.description: Legacy: max slippage as a fraction (0.01 = 1%). Send slippageBps or slippage, not both.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points (100 = 1%). Default 100.

tokenIn.description: Token sold: a 0x address or a Heat id.

tokenOut.description: Token bought: a 0x address or a Heat id.
